**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, 02:12–02:14Z) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Within ~35 seconds the connection pool hit 20/20 in use and stayed pinned there, so every new request queued behind it and timed out with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`. The wait queue kept growing instead of draining — up over 80 queued by the end of the log.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14 02:14:18Z, first error `req-07401 /v1/cart -> billing-svc 503`. Still failing at the last line in the log, 03:59:27Z — never recovered on its own. Gateway only. Workers stayed clean the whole time, jobs finishing normally with single-digit `db_wait`.

**Rollback target:** `dep-4471` — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`.

One thing to flag before you roll back: `dep-4472` (billing-svc, 02:41Z) and `dep-4473` (catalog-svc, 03:20Z) both shipped *during* the outage. Worth a quick look that they didn't also land config touching the pool, since they're both unverified against a clean baseline.
